title: The Tortoise and the Hare
simplified_paragraphs: 从前，一个美丽的村子里有一只乌龟和一只兔子，它们决定举行一场跑步比赛。
比赛开始后，乌龟一步一步地往前爬，非常有耐心。它知道自己爬得慢，但它也相信，只要坚持，一定会成功。
兔子很快地跑起来，好像很容易赢得比赛。它看到乌龟离自己很远，觉得自己肯定赢了，于是，兔子决定在路边的树下休息一会儿。
虽然乌龟爬得很慢，但它一步一步地接近终点，一直没有停。当兔子醒来时，发现乌龟已经快到终点线了。兔子非常惊讶，马上跑起来。但无论兔子多努力，还是输了比赛。大家对这个结果都很惊讶。
这场比赛告诉我们，只要我们努力、不骄傲、坚持到最后，就能取得成功。
traditional_paragraphs: 從前，一個美麗的村子裡有一隻烏龜和一隻兔子，它們決定舉行一場跑步比賽。
比賽開始後，烏龜一步一步地往前爬，非常有耐心。它知道自己爬得慢，但它也相信，只要堅持，一定會成功。
兔子很快地跑起來，好像很容易贏得比賽。它看到烏龜離自己很遠，覺得自己肯定贏了，於是，兔子決定在路邊的樹下休息一會兒。
雖然烏龜爬得很慢，但它一步一步地接近終點，一直沒有停。當兔子醒來時，發現烏龜已經快到終點線了。兔子非常驚訝，馬上跑起來。但無論兔子多努力，還是輸了比賽。大家對這個結果都很驚訝。
這場比賽告訴我們，只要我們努力、不驕傲、堅持到最後，就能取得成功。

english_paragraphs: Once upon a time, there lived a tortoise and a hare in a beautiful village, and they decided to have a running race.
After the game started, the turtle crawled forward step by step, very patiently. It knows that it climbs slowly, but it also believes that as long as it persists, it will succeed.

The rabbit ran very quickly, as if it was easy to win the race. It saw the tortoise far away from itself and felt that it must have won, so the hare decided to rest for a while under a tree on the roadside.

Although the turtle crawled very slowly, it approached the end step by step and never stopped. When the hare woke up, he found that the tortoise was almost at the finish line. The rabbit was very surprised and started running immediately. But no matter how hard the rabbit tried, he still lost the game. Everyone was surprised by this result.
This game tells us that as long as we work hard, are not proud, and persist until the end, we can achieve success.
english_full:
Once upon a time, there lived a tortoise and a hare in a beautiful village, and they decided to have a running race.

After the game started, the turtle crawled forward step by step, very patiently. It knows that it climbs slowly, but it also believes that as long as it persists, it will succeed.

The rabbit ran very quickly, as if it was easy to win the race. It saw the tortoise far away from itself and felt that it must have won, so the hare decided to rest for a while under a tree on the roadside.

Although the turtle crawled very slowly, it approached the end step by step and never stopped. When the hare woke up, he found that the tortoise was almost at the finish line. The rabbit was very surprised and started running immediately. But no matter how hard the rabbit tried, he still lost the game. Everyone was surprised by this result.

This game tells us that as long as we work hard, are not proud, and persist until the end, we can achieve success.
